exports.name: ReadyState
exports.summary: The `ReadyState` describe the state of a `WebSocket` connection.

members.name: CLOSED
members.summary: The connection is closed or couldn't be opened.

members.name: CLOSING
members.summary: The connection is in the process of closing.

members.name: CONNECTING
members.summary: Socket has been created. The connection is not yet open.

members.name: OPEN
members.summary: The connection is open and ready to communicate.

members.name: addEventListener
members.type: addEventListener(type: T, callback?: (event: EventMap[T]) => void): void

params.name: type
params.description: A case-sensitive string representing the event type to listen for.

params.name: callback
params.description: The function that receives a notification. See `@lynx-js/websocket#EventMap` for details of events.

members.summary: The `addEventListener()` method of the `EventTarget` interface sets up a function that will be called whenever the specified event is delivered to the target.

members.name: close
members.summary: The `close()` method closes the [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) connection or connection attempt, if any.
members.remarks: If the connection is already [`CLOSED `](api:WebSocket.CLOSED), this method does nothing.

members.name: ping
members.summary: The `ping` method send an empty message to the server over the [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) connection.
members.remarks: It will throw an exception if you call `ping()` when the connection is in the [`CONNECTING `](api:WebSocket.CONNECTING) state. If you call `ping()` when the connection is in the [`CLOSING `](api:WebSocket.CLOSING) or [`CLOSED `](api:WebSocket.CLOSED) states, it will silently discard the data.

members.name: removeEventListener
members.type: removeEventListener(type: T, callback: (event: EventMap[T]) => void): void

params.name: type
params.description: The type of event to stop listening for.

params.name: callback
params.description: The function to remove as an event listener.

members.summary: The `removeEventListener()` method of the `EventTarget` interface removes an event listener from the WebSocket.

members.name: send

params.name: data
params.description: The specified data to be transmitted.

members.summary: The `send` method send the specified data to be transmitted to the server over the [`WebSocket`](api:WebSocket) connection.
members.remarks: It will throw an exception if you call `send()` when the connection is in the [`CONNECTING `](api:WebSocket.CONNECTING) state. If you call `send()` when the connection is in the [`CLOSING `](api:WebSocket.CLOSING) or [`CLOSED `](api:WebSocket.CLOSED) states, it will silently discard the data.
